{3: 'Somewhere on the outskirts atop a high ledge, night hangs heavy, and the wind is cold. Coaxed by the gust, a lone pebble tumbles forward and rolls over the edge, swallowed by the darkness below.'}
{3: 'As it happens, you are seated atop a missile-shaped metal cylinder, no more than a foot from the edge of the cliff.'}
{2: "We're quite high up, Jetavie. Are we really taking off on this missile?", 3: '6'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jetavie', 3: "...How rude. This is my adorable magical broom! Can't you tell what it is, Chosen One?", 4: '1'}
{3: "A few days earlier, Constellia's mechanoids finished building a two-person aircraft, and Jetavie and you have been handpicked to test-fly it."}
{2: 'Magical broom?', 3: '10'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "You know how ancient humans had brooms that'd go whoosh with a magic spell?", 4: '1', 17: '1'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Well, today's spell requires your Mind Beacon and me working in sync. In other words, this thing runs on our synchronization rate!", 4: '1', 22: '1'}
{2: 'Synchronization rate... That sounds suspicious.', 3: '15'}
{2: 'And why exactly are we doing this in a no-fly zone?', 3: '16'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "You've been cooped up on Babylonia for far too long, Chosen One. Life is about breaking free from what holds you back, and a no-fly zone is no exception.", 4: '1'}
{2: "We're so high up, and this thing hasn't been tested... Any safety measures?", 3: '19'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'I am the safety measure, so stop overthinking everything. Are you ready? Three, two...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wait, wait, wait, wait—', 3: '24', 4: "I'm not ready.", 5: '24'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Let's go!", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory550.jpg'}
{1: '1003', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory550.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: '“咻”——毫无预兆地被甩向了前方的百米高空，世界在眼前疯狂地旋转。'}
{2: 'UGH—', 3: '41', 4: "Jetavie... I think I'm going to be sick.", 5: '41'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Relax! A little dizziness is perfectly normal. You're way too tense, Chosen One.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Is there a spell that can control the broom? One that keeps us alive?', 3: '44', 4: "Witch lady, where's your spell—", 5: '44'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Spell? Oh right. Any spell will do, if that's what you need to calm down.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'Go on then, Chosen One. Shout it out yourself.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'In the name of Gestalt the Dark God!', 3: '50', 4: '(Unintelligible gibberish)', 5: '52'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'The old hag is still up in Babylonia. How is she supposed to swoop in and save you?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'What are you even babbling about?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'With your "spell" and your Mind Beacon working in tandem, the broom\'s frantic thrashing finally eases.'}
{3: 'Right then, Jetavie smirks.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'Dropping your guard already? Well then... how about this?', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFallNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: 'Whatever keeps you afloat suddenly vanishes, and the broom plummets.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFallNew.prefab'}
{3: 'You yank the broom upward on pure instinct, and it shoots skyward immediately, as if some invisible hand is hurling it straight toward the heavens.'}
{3: 'You cannot stop it, no matter what you do. You turn around and look at Jetavie—'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Her chin propped in her hand, she is clearly delighted by how flustered you are.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: '1003', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{3: 'Jetavie offers no help, while the broom keeps climbing faster and higher. The wind shrieks past you as the air grows thin, and darkness looms closer with every second—'}
{3: 'A pair of hands suddenly cover yours. You can feel her cold fingertips.'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Easy. There's no need to rush.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'Here, nice and slow. Put your hands right here, on the side of the broom.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her grip on your hand is firm yet gentle, the way a teacher would guide a child.'}
{2: '(Let Jetavie guide you)', 3: '93', 4: '(Shake Jetavie off and do it yourself)', 5: '94'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "That's it. You're doing good.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Behave. Don't fight me on this. Not yet.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Without warning, she presses your hands harder, forcing your palms flat against the side of the broom.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}
{3: "Following Jetavie's guidance, your synchronization rate climbs back toward normal. The broom still shudders here and there, but it is mostly under control again."}
{3: 'You glance back, and see a small, unmistakably smug grin on her face.'}
{2: "Why didn't you teach me earlier?", 3: '102'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'Aww, are you upset?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She pokes her cheek, her eyes crinkled with amusement.'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'Oh, and did I tell you how adorable you looked when you were flopping around like that?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "You're not used to flying with me yet, but you will be.", 4: '1'}
{2: "We've been flying in a no-fly zone. Will there be a problem?", 3: '108'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Relax. I won't let anyone interrupt our magical ride... more or less.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She hums to herself, her legs swinging idly back and forth. Every so often, she gives you a little kick from behind, then sits back to enjoy the sight of you losing your balance.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen03.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Finally getting a chance to breathe, you try to enjoy the bumpy ride, the biting wind, and the trail of light behind you.'}
{3: 'Wait... why is there light trailing behind you?'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen03.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Warning. Warning. Unidentified flying explosive detected. <color=#ff4e4eff><size=60>Engaging emergency evasion protocol.</size></color>'}
{1: 'Terminal', 2: 'Warning. Warning. Unidentified flying explosive detected. Engaging emergency evasion protocol.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'Those <phonetic=unawakened mechanoids>idiots</phonetic> actually loaded something like that on this thing.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The broom shudders beneath you, straining like a caged animal desperate to break out.', 17: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFallNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: 'Then, with one violent jerk, it plunges.', 22: '1'}
{3: 'The sky spins. Your mind spins. Every last one of your organs spins with the broom.'}
{2: "Jetavie, we're in free fall—", 3: '135'}
{3: 'She is fully airborne, letting out an ecstatic "Whooooo!" as if she is having the time of her life on a rollercoaster.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jetavie', 3: "There are no tracks or missions in the open sky! There's nothing that will wear you down, Chosen One! I'm going to make today the best day of your life!", 4: '1'}
{2: "At this rate, it'll be the last day of my life!", 3: '139'}
{3: 'The ground<//THE LINE BETWEEN LIFE AND DEATH> quickly approaches, and you feel like your soul is about to tear free from your body.'}
{2: 'How are you so calm right now, Jetavie—', 3: '142'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Because I won't let that happen.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFallNew.prefab'}
{1: '1003', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.7', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Your eyes meet hers once more amid the spinning chaos, and they are still sharp and unshaken. Then, time stretches to a standstill.'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Listen up, Chosen One. We can talk while we're inside my simulated M.I.N.D., but we've only got three seconds outside.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "An emergency protocol has locked us out of the broom's controls, and we need a synchronization rate above 95% to override it. So if your mind wavers even a little like it just did, we're toasted.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'So just... breathe. Let yourself fully relax, okay?', 4: '1'}
{2: "Relax? While we're falling?", 3: '160', 4: 'Just... let myself fall?', 5: '160'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "This only works if you and I work together, so... don't fight it.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'There is a strange pull to her voice: dangerous, sweet... and utterly disarming.'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'Hand your Mind Beacon to me, all of it. Let me hold you... Trust and accept me...', 4: '1'}
{2: '(Relax and establish a Deep M.I.N.D. connection with Jetavie)', 3: '167', 4: '(Refuse to rely on Jetavie and try to control the broom yourself)', 5: '184'}
{3: 'You stop thinking about the fall, the direction, or what to do next. One by one, you let go of everything you hold onto, letting them all fall into her hands.'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: 'The rush of wind grows distant, and your body stops feeling like yours. In its place is a warm, enveloping darkness...'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Within it is her breath, her warmth, and the faint curve of her smile. It is triumphant, content, tender, and a little willful.'}
{3: 'Her word of reassurance travels through your body like a thread of silk, gathering up and putting away all your fear, weightlessness, and vertigo.'}
{3: 'And then, the world begins to rise.'}
{3: 'Your Mind Beacon runs at full power, forcing the broom to angle slightly, but it is not stopping the freefall. Below, the forest opens its ravenous maw, ready to swallow you whole.'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: 'A pair of arms wraps around you without warning, and the world goes dark. There is nothing left but the sharp crack and rustle of branches tearing past your ears.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'It all happens in an instant. Holding you in her arms, Jetavie is keeping you warm and safe, as if nothing outside can hurt you...'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFallNew.prefab'}
{3: '"I can\'t let these arms get hurt." Thinking that, you finally stop the broom\'s descent with your Mind Beacon, and the world slowly begins to rise.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory550.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'When you come back to your senses, the broom is gliding steadily through the sky, and Jetavie is somehow sitting in front of you.'}
{2: 'Thank you, Jetavie.', 3: '209', 4: 'We made it.', 5: '209'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "For the Chosen One to make a choice like that... that's quite the compliment for me, you know. Whether it was offering me all your trust... or claiming all of mine.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She laughs, her smile too wide to hide the joy of having just caused a little trouble.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Whoosh! Something bright suddenly streaks past you—it is the trail of light that was chasing you earlier.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'One after another, they arc across the night sky, trailing long ribbons of silver and illuminating the dark horizon.'}
{2: 'These silver streaks are...', 3: '222'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen03.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jetavie', 3: '"Contraband" in the no-fly zone, "unidentified flying explosives" trailing our broom, "mysterious treasures" the world offered the great wizard, and—', 4: '1'}
{2: "Jetavie's gift to the Chosen One.", 3: '226'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "You're getting better at reading my heart, Chosen One. That's probably why our synchronization rate managed to hit 95%.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: "Then again, 95% means there's still room to grow... Maybe someday we'll fully understand each other. Who knows?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She tilts her head with a pleased little smile, her adorable fangs peeking out the corner of her mouth.'}
{2: 'Jetavie', 3: 'Anyway... happy Double Seventh Festival, Chosen One.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Silver stars brighten Jetavie\'s face. Filled with "magic," the broom carries the two of you, drifting slowly.'}
{3: 'The night sky stretches above you, seemingly boundless.'}
